strengths: Guard precedence is centralized in getSwitchAttemptState (noop → hydration → active session → unsaved edits) with matching unit coverage
BoardContext routes focus-loading and focus-blocked through warning toasts without switching or persisting workspace id; no FocusSessionContext import
WorkspaceSwitcher forwards hasActiveFocusSession and focusSessionHydrated to the pure guard and closes the dropdown on focus statuses while keeping confirm-required open
Integration tests exercise the real guard end-to-end (no mock of getSwitchAttemptState) with separate cases for active-session block, hydrated allow, and hydration block
Refs mirror the existing hasUnsavedRef pattern to avoid stale closures in attemptSwitchWorkspace

issues.description: getSwitchAttemptState is evaluated twice per sidebar selection (WorkspaceSwitcher for menu state, BoardContext for routing) — pre-existing pattern, not a policy duplicate, but worth noting for future consolidation
